  • Oversee the accounting treatment of assets and activities related to the UK business classified as "Held for Sale"

  • Further develop an effective internal control system
  • Serve as the central point of contact for complex accounting and financial reporting matters under HGB and IFRS (including IFRS 16, IFRS 5, impairment testing, purchase price allocations, intercompany reconciliations, foreign currency valuation)

  • Act as a business partner to operational units on financial matters and investment decisions
  • Lead the realignment and modernization of the European accounting function
  • Lead the Dynamics 365 Business Central upgrade and the standardization/digitalization of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing accounting team (recruiting, coaching, development)

Requirements

Must-have

  • Completed degree in business administration, finance, accounting, or a comparable field
  • Several years of leadership experience in accounting within an international company
  • Proven experience managing multiple entities and countries
  • Strong hands-on operational accounting experience
  • Excellent knowledge of accounting under HGB and IFRS
  • Fluent in English; German language skills are mandatory

Nice-to-have

  • Qualification as a certified public accountant (Wirtschaftsprüfer), tax advisor (Steuerberater), or comparable

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable ERP systems
  • Strong communication, leadership, and change management skills

  • Attractive compensation with additional benefits such as Christmas and holiday bonuses, plus performance bonuses
  • Company pension scheme

Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Innenarchitektur und hochwertigen Einrichtung, ob Business, In- oder Outdoor. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere KundInnen dabei jederzeit in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Marketing-Teams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Social Media nicht nur bespielt, sondern versteht, wie aus einer starken Marke relevanter Content entsteht, strategisch gedacht, hochwertig umgesetzt und nah an unseren unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen. Aufgaben Social Media weiterdenken: Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media-Präsenz für B2B- und B2C-Zielgruppen kontinuierlich weiter und übersetzt unsere Marke in relevante digitale Formate. Content produzieren: Du entwickelst Ideen und setzt Social-Media-Content eigenständig um, von Text und Storytelling über Foto und Video bis hin zu wiederkehrenden Formaten. Produktionen steuern: Du koordinierst Foto-, Video- und Grafikproduktionen und arbeitest dabei mit KollegInnen sowie externen Partnern zusammen. Community aufbauen: Du betreust unsere Community aktiv, beantwortest Nachrichten und Kommentare und entwickelst den Dialog mit unseren Zielgruppen weiter. Trends erkennen: Du beobachtest Plattformen, Formate und gesellschaftliche sowie gestalterische Trends und bewertest, was davon wirklich zu Mathes passt. Performance: Du analysierst Reichweite, Interaktionen, Leads und weitere relevante KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungen für unseren Content ab. description: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! Benefits At NVISO, we care. title: Heartbeat AI Partnerships Manager (m/f/d)
description: 1KOMMA5° At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. Learn about our Product & Tech team! Deine Position As part of the Heartbeat Tech domain, you will own our partnerships with hardware manufacturers that connect to Heartbeat AI. You're the person who finds and excites new partners about Heartbeat AI, then negotiates the resulting agreements, and finally makes sure the integration actually gets delivered. But it doesn’t stop there: You will own the relationship long-term and ensure it turns in a true win-win situation. Key responsibilities include but are not limited to: Partnership Sales: Identify and pitch the Heartbeat AI vision to selected hardware manufacturers, get them onboard our vision and carry conversations from first contact through to signed partnership. Contract Management: Lead commercial and legal negotiations for all contractual elements to ensure a solid partnership basis with terms that work for both sides. Project Management: Coordinate the technical integration to delivery — sequencing work with our development teams, tracking milestones, and unblocking issues on both sides. Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day relationship with each partner post go-live — be their primary point of contact, manage escalations, and keep the partnership healthy and growing. Portfolio Ownership: Maintain an overview of all Heartbeat AI partnerships, their contractual status, technical maturity and roadmap, and report on the health of the partner portfolio to leadership. In addition identify gaps and pursue opportunites to build the strongest partnership portfolio in the market. title: Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team and support the company's global sales organisation. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed.</p> <p>The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests.</p> <p>This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions.</li> <li>Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs.</li> <li>Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes.</li> <li>Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required.</li> <li>Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays.</li> <li>Support the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks and legal processes, and develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote best practices and understanding of legal risks, contracting principles and company processes.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture.</li> </ul> <h4>What You’ll Bring</h4> <ul> <li>Qualified lawyer with significant (8-12+ years) post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department but including significant in-house experience.</li> <li>Strong commercial contracts background, ideally within a software, SaaS, cloud technology or broader technology company.</li> <li>Excellent drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.</li> <li>Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner.</li> <li>Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk proportionately. Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive discussions to achieve the best outcome for the business.</li> <li>Proactive, self-motivated and willing to take ownership of complex matters from start to finish.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of matters and conflicting priorities.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts, articulate recommendations and options, and deliver practical advice that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the confidence to make risk-based decisions in situations where there may not be a clear precedent or established playbook.</li> </ul> <div class="content-pay-transparency"> <div class="pay-input"> <div class="description"> <p><strong>What you'll get</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares</li> <li>Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment</li> <li>Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection</li> <li>Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary</li> <li>Defined contribution pension plan with employer match</li> <li>Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs</li> <li>Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> <p>#LI-MP1</p><div title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Samsara’s UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We’ve scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we’re now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.&nbsp;</p> <p>This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You’ll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK’s largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.&nbsp;</p> <p>The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.</p> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h4> <ul> <li>Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts</li> <li>Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms</li> <li>Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level</li> <li>Develop your reps’ ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara’s expanding product portfolio against a customer’s most critical business priorities</li> <li>Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn’t a role where you sit above the deals</li> <li>Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK’s largest accounts</li> <li>Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team</span></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment</li> <li>Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression</li> <li>Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one</li> <li>A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers</li> <li>Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you’re expected to build process while delivering results</li> <li>A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance. Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision. We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next! About the role We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director. This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better. You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them. Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says. You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us? We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better. If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you. Who are you? You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently. You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite. You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently. In practice: You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data. You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them. You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS. You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change. What we need from you Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes. Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems. Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight. Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Operations better. An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. Confidence working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech in a fast-moving environment. It would also be great if you have: Experience in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment. Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice. A background in accountancy, audit, management consulting or another analytically rigorous environment that has given you strong foundations in numerical reasoning, process, controls or data. And one thing you won't need? A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name. raw.description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

  • You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

  • You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems.

  • Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Operations better.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate.

  • Confidence working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech in a fast-moving environment.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

  • A background in accountancy, audit, management consulting or another analytically rigorous environment that has given you strong foundations in numerical reasoning, process, controls or data.

And one thing you won't need?

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia. The key elements we’re looking for are: Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data. A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart. DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. title: AI Integration Lead
description: <p><strong>Department overview:</strong></p> <p>The Front Office AI Technology Team sits within the Front Office Technology department and provides a shared capability for the development, operation, and adoption of AI across the firm. The team is responsible for building and supporting enterprise‑grade AI capabilities, including LLM‑powered applications, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) systems, agent‑assisted workflows, and scalable internal AI tooling.</p> <p>We develop the core AI foundations required to deploy AI safely and at scale, while also working closely with the business to ensure these capabilities are used effectively in day‑to‑day workflows. This includes supporting experimentation, guiding practical adoption, and helping teams embed AI into real processes where it delivers measurable benefit.</p> <p>A key focus of The Front Office AI Technology Team is ensuring that AI solutions are reliable, secure, and aligned with the firm’s control and risk frameworks. The team balances innovation with discipline, providing common tooling, patterns, and guidance that allow AI to be used consistently and responsibly across research and operational contexts.</p> <p><strong>Role overview:</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>AI Enablement &amp; Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a go‑to point of contact for teams who want to understand what AI tools are available and how to use them effectively.</li> <li>Run workshops, demos, and hands‑on sessions that help users understand the benefit of using LLMs and emerging AI related technologies both for business users and more technical teams.</li> <li>Support day‑to‑day adoption of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and Claude alongside other approved AI tools by embedding them into real workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Training &amp; Best Practice</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver practical training on prompt engineering, AI limitations, and good usage patterns for both technical and non‑technical audiences.</li> <li>Create and maintain reusable materials such as prompt examples/libraries, walkthroughs, and short guidance notes.</li> <li>Continuously refine training content based on user feedback and emerging best practice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Understanding Business Processes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spend time with teams to understand their existing processes, pain points, and where work is slow, repetitive, or manual.</li> <li>Help teams articulate problems clearly enough that AI tooling can be applied sensibly.</li> <li>Map simple end‑to‑end workflows and identify realistic opportunities for AI assistance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Light Prototyping &amp; Applied AI</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build simple prototypes or proof‑of‑concept workflows using Python, internal libraries, or approved AI APIs alongside tools such as MS Copilot Studio.</li> <li>Pair with engineers or platform teams when ideas move beyond quick prototypes.</li> <li>Focus on small, shippable improvements rather than large, speculative solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Feedback &amp; Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collect structured feedback on what works, what doesn’t, and where users get stuck.</li> <li>Share insights with The Front Office AI Tech Team, governance, and Infrastructure Tech teams to help guide tooling, documentation, and prioritisation.</li> <li>Help surface recurring themes rather than one‑off requests.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Adoption Metrics, Reporting &amp; Insight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the definition and tracking of adoption metrics for approved internal AI tools.</li> <li>Work with Front Office Technology and platform teams to help maintain simple reporting and dashboards that show usage and engagement patterns (for example: active users, frequency of use, and common use cases).</li> <li>Monitor adoption trends and identify areas of low engagement or friction that may require additional enablement, training, or tooling changes.</li> <li>Combine quantitative usage data with qualitative user feedback to build a clear view of how AI tools are being used in practice.</li> <li>Share regular adoption insights with relevant stakeholders to inform prioritisation of training materials, documentation, and incremental improvements to AI tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why this role exists:</strong></p> <p>The firm is investing heavily in modern AI platforms and tools, but technology alone does not create value. Real impact comes when teams change how they work. This role exists to help front‑office and technology teams translate AI capability into everyday practice, replacing one‑off experimentation with well‑understood patterns, better habits, and repeatable workflows. Through hands‑on enablement, training, and applied problem‑solving, the AI Integration Lead ensures that AI use is both effective and appropriately governed, allowing teams to move faster without increasing operational or compliance risk.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different:<br></strong><br>This role offers the chance to work directly with trading desks, providing a rare and exciting opportunity to gain direct front-office exposure. You’ll work at the intersection of business context and applied AI: understanding how teams operate, then helping them adopt approved AI tools safely and effectively through training, workflow mapping, and lightweight prototyping. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys ambiguity, values practical impact over hype, and wants to see their work change how teams operate day-to-day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated interest in evolving applied AI technologies and their use in improving real business processes in a practical and controlled manner.</li> <li>Experience delivering or supporting training, workshops, or enablement sessions for technical and non‑technical audiences.</li> <li>Hands‑on experience using modern AI tools beyond typical end‑user interaction, including: <br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; - Practical understanding of prompt engineering techniques and common LLM failure modes<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; - Experience grounding AI outputs in data (e.g. through document retrieval, APIs, MCP or structured context rather than free‑text prompting alone)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; - Exposure to designing AI‑assisted workflows that support repeatable tasks rather than one‑off interactions.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise and low‑code AI tooling, such as Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Claude Cowork, or similar workflow and AI enablement platforms.</li> <li>Practical experience assessing AI output quality and limitations for real business use cases, and iterating prompts or workflows to improve reliability.</li> <li>Comfortable working with Python at a practical level (scripts, APIs, data handling), without requiring production‑grade engineering expertise.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non‑technical users.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements, and able to iterate pragmatically rather than waiting for complete specifications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) concepts at a practical level, such as working with internal documents or structured reference data.</li> <li>Experience designing or supporting simple AI‑assisted workflows for document handling, summarisation, data extraction, or knowledge access.</li> <li>Awareness of responsible AI considerations in regulated environments, including basic data handling, validation of outputs, and appropriate human review.</li> <li>Exposure to lightweight agent‑style patterns (e.g. tool use, structured outputs, task decomposition), without requiring ownership of complex agent frameworks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>You are a bright and approachable individual who works well with others and enjoys understanding how different teams operate in practice. You are comfortable engaging with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders and are able to communicate clearly and pragmatically. Alongside your technical experience, you may bring experience from a client‑facing or commercially oriented role earlier in your career, which helps you understand business priorities and frame solutions in a way that resonates with users.</p> <p>You have a strong interest in applied AI and a genuine curiosity about how emerging tools can improve the way people work. You are motivated to explore new capabilities, experiment hands‑on, and understand where AI can add value in real workflows. Your approach is practical rather than theoretical, and you are focused on achievable improvements rather than technology for its own sake.</p> <p>You take a considered and responsible approach to AI integration. You are aware of the limitations of AI tools and the importance of appropriate controls, validation, and oversight, particularly in a regulated environment. You are comfortable discussing both the benefits and constraints of AI with users, helping set realistic expectations and encouraging sensible use.</p> <p>You work well in collaborative environments where priorities and requirements evolve. You are adaptable, open to feedback, and comfortable learning by doing. You take satisfaction from helping others build confidence with new tools and from supporting inte across teams, bringing a constructive and measured mindset to your work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. As an employer, we provide equal opportunities to all people regardless of their gender, marital or civil partnership status, race, religion or ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation or nationality. </em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Hybrid, Holborn Gate, London<br><strong>Vacancy Type:</strong> Permanent, full time <br><strong>Reporting to:</strong> Head of Innovation</p> <h4>About STEMAI</h4> <p>STEM AI is transforming how life sciences organisations access insights through AI-powered solutions. As our platform expands, we are looking for a Client Success Coordinator to ensure clients move seamlessly from pilot agreement through to successful implementation. This newly created role sits at the heart of the client journey, coordinating complex approval activities and working across technical, legal, commercial and operational teams to remove barriers and accelerate commissioning.</p> <h4>The Opportunity</h4> <p>Following agreement to pilot STEM AI, clients typically complete multiple internal approval processes covering information security, IT, legal, procurement, compliance, data privacy and operational readiness. Every organisation has different governance requirements, making this a highly collaborative role requiring excellent organisation and stakeholder management.<br><br>You will become the central point of coordination, ensuring requests are managed efficiently, the right subject matter experts are engaged, responses are prepared to a high standard and clients receive a professional, responsive experience.</p> <h4>Key Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Coordinate all client approval activities to drive pilot commitment.</li> <li>Act as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation approval journey.</li> <li>Manage questionnaires, security assessments and due diligence requests.</li> <li>Coordinate responses from technical, legal, compliance, commercial and operational teams.</li> <li>Track milestones, manage deadlines and proactively resolve blockers.</li> <li>Prepare high-quality responses using existing knowledge libraries and previous submissions.</li> <li>Maintain and continually improve the central repository of approved responses and documentation.</li> <li>Provide regular progress updates to internal stakeholders and escalate risks where required.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to streamline approval activity processes and improve the client experience.</li> <li>Support successful pilot launches by ensuring approvals are completed accurately and on time.</li> </ul> <h4>About You</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in client success, implementation, project coordination, PMO or programme management.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Confidence working with senior internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Highly collaborative with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.</li> <li>Experience within AI, healthcare or life sciences is advantageous but not essential.</li> </ul> <h4>Why Join STEMAI?</h4> <p>This is an opportunity to help shape a new AI offering from the ground up. You will play a pivotal role in creating a best-in-class client onboarding experience, working alongside innovation, technology and commercial teams to build scalable processes that directly contribute to faster implementations, improved client satisfaction and business growth.</p> <p>Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our STEM team uses benchmarking through AI-enabled and evidence-based approaches to drive alignment resulting in accelerated performance. Serving clients across brand &amp; commercial, Medical Affairs &amp; sales, our expertise includes data, research &amp; insights (proprietary benchmarking data), strategic brand alignment, and sales &amp; MSL performance benchmarking. Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.</p> <p>Find us here:</p> <p>Website: <a href="http://www.inizio.com/ourbusinesses/ignite">www.inizio.com/ourbusinesses/ignite</a></p> <p><em>STEM Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer.&nbsp; STEM Healthcare will consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, sex or sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity leave status, race or national or ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, gender identity or re-assignment, marital or civil partnership status, protected veteran status (if applicable) or any other characteristic protected by law. STEM Healthcare only employs individuals with the right to work in the country/ies where the role is advertised.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
description: <p><strong>About BakerHicks</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.</p> <p>Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Bridges Team</strong></p> <p>At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.</p> <p>We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.</p> <p>This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.<br>Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.</p> <p>We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p>We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:</p> <ul> <li>General inspections</li> <li>Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment</li> <li>Safety, special and reactive inspections</li> <li>Inspections for assessment and monitoring</li> <li>Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)</li> <li>Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks</li> <li>Railway structures</li> <li>Inspection and access planning, and reporting</li> <li>Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:</p> <ul> <li>Road and rail bridges, including footbridges</li> <li>Culverts and buried structures</li> <li>Retaining walls</li> <li>Tunnel structures</li> <li>Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures</li> <li>Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections</li> <li>Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Knowledge &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p>Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:</p> <ul> <li>Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types</li> <li>Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant</li> <li>Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations</li> <li>Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.</li> <li>Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations</li> <li>Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains</li> <li>Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators</li> <li>IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:</p> <ul> <li>Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments</li> <li>Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience</li> <li>Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable</li> <li>IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable</li> <li>Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification</li> <li>For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties</li> <li>Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why Register Your Interest?</strong></p> <p>By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability</li> <li>Build a working relationship with BakerHicks</li> <li>Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals</li> <li>Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How to Register Your Interest</strong></p> <p>Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.<br><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Engagement Details</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)</li> <li>Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)</li> <li>Locations across the UK</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.&nbsp;The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements.&nbsp;In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.</em></p> <p><em>Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (</em><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels"><em>National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK</em></a><em>)&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About BakerHicks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see:&nbsp;<a href="https://bakerhicks.com/en/about">About | BakerHicks</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>BakerHicks. A&nbsp;<a href="https://www.morgansindall.com/">Morgan Sindall Group</a>&nbsp;company.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>About Threecolts</strong></h4> <p>Threecolts is the leading software suite for online &amp; offline consumer brands (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Shopify, eBay, etc.). You communicate clearly, work well with cross-functional teams, and look for ways to improve both the product and how the team operates.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll support Inventory Lab, a product used by ecommerce sellers to manage inventory, listing, accounting, and operational workflows. The work will suit someone who enjoys solving practical product problems, improving reliability, and building systems that support real customer use cases.<br><br><strong>⛳️ Compensation, Perks &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Salary: £ 110,000 per year</li> <li value="1">25 days PTO</li> <li value="1">Healthcare &amp; Pension benefits&nbsp;</li> <li value="1">Opportunity to join company-wide offsites</li> <li value="2">Regular rate reviews and bonus opportunities</li> <li value="3">Fully remote/hybrid working</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver scalable, high-impact products that create measurable business value and strong adoption.</p> <p>The successful candidate will combine disciplined product management with experience in data products, AI, commercialization, stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. The final role level will reflect the scope of the position and the experience of the successful candidate.</p> <p><strong><u>Why we’re hiring</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>To establish and execute a clear product strategy for WPP’s Agentic Data Platform.</li> <li>To turn complex data and AI capabilities into scalable products that solve meaningful business and customer problems.</li> <li>To connect product investment, adoption and commercialization with measurable value across WPP’s global network.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>What you’ll be doing</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across multiple data platform products and initiatives.</li> <li>Translate customer, user, market and business needs into clear product priorities and outcomes.</li> <li>Lead products through discovery, validation, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Governance and Market teams to deliver high-quality products.</li> <li>Define success measures and use data to track adoption, value, quality, cost and commercial performance.</li> <li>Develop product economics and commercialization approaches, balancing customer value, business objectives, speed, quality and scalability.</li> <li>Advance AI, agent and workflow automation opportunities through responsible experimentation, while ensuring appropriate governance, privacy, security and data quality.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How your time may be focused</strong></p> <p>The role is expected to be approximately&nbsp;<strong>70% individual contribution and 30% leadership/management</strong>, with the balance adapting to business needs.</p> <p><strong><u>In this role, you will:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Create alignment around a compelling product vision and prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>Move complex data and AI initiatives from strategy into valuable, adopted products.</li> <li>Establish clear measures for product performance, customer value and commercial impact.</li> <li>Build strong partnerships across technical, commercial, governance and market teams.</li> <li>Help develop product talent and strengthen product management practices across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Who you’ll be working with</u></strong></p> <p>You’ll work across a global, matrixed environment with colleagues in:</p> <ul> <li>Engineering and Data Science</li> <li>Data Operations and Governance</li> <li>Commercial and Partnerships</li> <li>Market and business teams</li> <li>Product, technology and senior executive leadership</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>What you’ll need</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant product management experience, including ownership of strategy, roadmaps and product lifecycles.</li> <li>A track record of building or scaling products in one or more of the following areas: data, analytics, advertising technology, Martech, SaaS, AI or enterprise platforms.</li> <li>Experience taking products from strategy and discovery through delivery, launch, adoption and iteration.</li> <li>Experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives or teams within a matrixed or global organization.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to connect customer needs with product economics, revenue drivers, costs and adoption.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of enterprise data platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data Science colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that would be valuable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or launching agentic, AI-native or workflow automation products.</li> <li>Working knowledge of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration.</li> <li>Experience working with responsible AI, data governance, privacy or security considerations in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience leading, coaching or developing product managers.</li> </ul> <p>We value relevant skills and experience gained through different career paths. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in place of rigid formal requirements.</p> <p><strong><u>How you lead</u></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic thinker:</strong>&nbsp;You connect product investments to business outcomes and build compelling, actionable roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong>&nbsp;You understand value creation, customer needs, product economics and adoption.</li> <li><strong>Influential collaborator:</strong>&nbsp;You build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities and resolve conflicts constructively.</li> <li><strong>Execution focused:</strong>&nbsp;You make informed decisions in ambiguous environments and balance speed, quality and scalability.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>You're open<em>:</em> </strong>We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.</p> <p><strong>You're optimistic<em>:</em></strong> <span id="628d56ad5d8a35dab853e65d9daa237c" class="editor-module-hl-green-solid">We believe</span> in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.</p> <p><strong>You're extraordinary:</strong> we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What we'll give you:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Passionate, inspired people</strong> – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.</p> <p><strong>Scale and opportunity</strong> – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.</p> <p><strong>Challenging and stimulating work</strong> – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</strong></p> <p><strong>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</strong></p> <h4><strong>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment">https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</strong></h4></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, Clinical Research - Neurodegeneration
description: <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer. This is an opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s rapidly expanding portfolio, which spans the areas of rare genetic diseases, cardio-metabolic diseases, neuroscience, hematology and hepatology.</p> <p>The successful candidate’s primary role will be to drive the pipeline forward through leadership of clinical development programs.&nbsp; While the primary focus responsibility will be as clinical lead physician on Alnylam’s Huntington’s program, the role may support across a range of therapeutic areas and all stages of development may be required as pipeline assets evolve. The Sr. Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence for associated clinical trials. In addition, this role will include interaction with Alnylam’s research group, helping to advise the team on the clinical development feasibility of novel targets and the design of proof-of-concept studies. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.</p> <p>The Senior Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial &amp; QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.</p> <p>This position is hybrid and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs</li> <li>Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts to secure global regulatory approvals</li> <li>Oversight of trial conduct and safety</li> <li>Provide strategic consultation and guidance to Research on all decisions that have significant clinical components and implications.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and Commercial to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans</li> <li>Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables</li> <li>Drive/supervise all major written deliverables&nbsp;(regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials</li> <li>Be responsible (as appropriate in line with SOPs) for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, IBs, informed consent forms</li> <li>Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>MD with strong research background or MD PhD, with a track record of successful research support and peer review publications. Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training is highly desirable; drug development experience in neurology (Huntington’s Disease) would be a great advantage, but not essential</li> <li>10+ years industry experience or equivalent clinical academic experience</li> <li>Sound scientific and clinical judgment</li> <li>Successful track record of leading Phase 2/3 clinical programs (preferably in Huntington’s drug development), including major interactions with Health Authorities</li> <li>Familiarity with concepts of clinical research and clinical trial design, including biostatistics, regulatory agency organization, guidelines, and practices</li> <li>Ability to effectively present ideas and document complex medical/clinical concepts in both written and oral communication</li> <li>History of solving problems while exhibiting superior judgment and a balanced, realistic understanding of issues</li> <li>Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills working within a matrix environment.</li> <li>Experience and knowledge of working with biotech/pharma partner(s) a plus</li> <li>Thrives in highly entrepreneurial biotech environment and embraces Alnylam’s culture of science, passion and urgency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Alnylam: </strong>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.</p> <p><strong>Our culture:</strong>&nbsp;Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.</p> <p>At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.</p> <p>Before applying, please review Alnylam's ⁠Candidate&nbsp;<a href="https://alnylampolicies.com/">Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;regarding how Alnylam handles Personal Data you provide with your application for employment.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
